::: {#exm-rss}
#### Residual sum of squares of a line through three points

For the points $(0, 1)$, $(1, 2)$, $(2, 2)$ and the line with $\intcoef = 1$ and $\coef{x} = 0.5$ (@exm-rss-slr),
the residuals are
$1 - 1 = 0$, $2 - 1.5 = 0.5$, and $2 - 2 = 0$,
so

$$
\begin{aligned}
  \text{RSS}(1, 0.5) &= 0^2 + 0.5^2 + 0^2 \\
  &= 0.25
\end{aligned}
$$

(@fig-rss-three-points).

::: {#fig-rss-three-points}

```{r}
rss_points <- tibble::tibble(x = c(0, 1, 2), y = c(1, 2, 2)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(fitted = 1 + 0.5 * x)

ggplot2::ggplot(rss_points, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(intercept = 1, slope = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    ggplot2::aes(xend = x, yend = fitted),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "firebrick"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.25, 2.25), ylim = c(0.75, 2.25))
```

The three points, the line with intercept 1 and slope 0.5,
and the one nonzero residual (dashed)
